summary: Frontend-only regression for two UX fixes on Price Buddy (live external backend). BUG 1 (shimmer speed) — VERIFIED: the CTA shimmer band sweeps slowly (~2.2s sweep + ~2.4s pause, ~4.6s full cycle) matching cta-shimmer.tsx; translateX sampled at 250ms intervals shows the band resting at end position (~400px) for ~2.0s, then jumping to -60 and sweeping back to 400 over ~2.3s — no console errors. BUG 2 (Energy details layout) — VERIFIED: with Electric+Gas both selected, both groups render with 10 supplier chips + 'I don't know', all visible with no truncation at 390px AND 320px viewports; helper text 'Providing your MPAN / MPRN speeds up your quote...' appears once per group (2 occurrences); Electric group above Gas with the groupDivider (borderTop + 22px paddingTop) providing clear separation; both 'Add another Electric Meter' and 'Add another Gas Meter' dashed buttons present. Regression: postcode 'EWTEW' shows the exact error 'Please enter a valid UK postcode (e.g. SW1A 1AA)' and Continue is aria-disabled and non-functional until fixed; full flow submitted live POST /api/quotes/multi -> 200 and Request received screen rendered with REFERENCE badge '0803B392' and 'What happens next:' card.

react_native_issues.issue: Animated.timing uses useNativeDriver: true but Expo web logs 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing. Falling back to JS-based animation.' — cosmetic on web (JS fallback works and the sweep timing is correct), but consider gating useNativeDriver by Platform.OS !== 'web' to silence the warning. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/cta-shimmer.tsx:11-14
Deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated, use 'boxShadow'; and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated, use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking but should be migrated in a follow-up.

action_items: Optional (non-blocking): gate CtaShimmer useNativeDriver behind Platform.OS !== 'web' to remove the Expo web warning.
Optional (non-blocking): migrate deprecated 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' and 'pointerEvents' prop to style.pointerEvents to clear console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: cta-shimmer.tsx timing values match the PR intent (2200ms sweep + 2400ms delay + 0ms reset). No issues.
quote/new.tsx MeterGroup applies styles.groupDivider only when !first, which correctly gives Gas group a borderTop + 22px paddingTop when it follows Electric.
SupplierPicker chip padding (14/9) + chipWrap gap match the described spacing increase; chip widths sampled 56–154px with no text truncation.
Postcode validation error text and Continue disabled state behave exactly as specified.
